== History ==
The exact date of establishment is unknown. The name "Todoroki" is believed to originate from a bridge that once existed within the shrine grounds. Another theory suggests it comes from referring to Inadahime as "Todorokihime," or from the sound of a babbling brook that once flowed through the grounds, with "Todoroki" meaning "roaring" or "resounding."<ref name="Osaka Health Association">[https://osaka-hk.org/posts/senjin125 Historical Overview of Todorokihimenomikoto Shrine - Osaka Health Association] Retrieved March 19, 2019</ref> Listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|式内社|2=ja|3=式内社|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|lt=Shikinaisha}} as a minor shrine, it is thought to have originally served as an auxiliary shrine (okunoin) to the {{ill|Sumiyoshi-taisha|de|Sumiyoshi-Taisha|es|Sumiyoshi Taisha|fa|سومییوشی-تایشا|fi|Sumiyoshi-taisha|fr|Sumiyoshi-taisha|it|Grande santuario di Sumiyoshi|ja|住吉大社|ko|스미요시 대사|la|Sumiyoshi-taisha|my|ဆုမိရောရှိနန်းကွန်းနန်းရင်း|pt|Sumiyoshi taisha|ru|Сумиёси-тайся|sl|Veliko svetišče Sumijoši-taiša|th|ศาลเจ้าซูมิโยชิ|tr|Sumiyoshi-taisha|uk|Сумійосі тайся|zh|住吉大社|qid=Q705949|lt=Sumiyoshi Taisha}}.

== Precincts ==
* Monument of the Wakamatsu Palace Site
* Stone Marker of {{ill|Amemiketsutoyora-no-Mikoto Shrine|ja|天水分豊浦命神社}} (Designated Cultural Property of Osaka City)

== Auxiliary Shrines ==
* {{ill|Amemiketsutoyora-no-Mikoto Shrine|ja|天水分豊浦命神社}} (Deities: {{ill|Sanbo Kojin|fr|Sanbō Kōjin|ja|三宝荒神|zh|三寶荒神|qid=Q13577821}} ({{ill|Mikumari|fr|Mikumari|ja|水分神|simple|Mikumari-no-Kami|sv|Mikumari-no-Kami|zh|水分神|qid=Q11129547|lt=Mikumari-no-Kami}}, {{ill|Okutsuhiko-no-Mikoto|ja|奥津彦命|qid=Q140446057}}, {{ill|Okutsuhime-no-Mikoto|ja|奥津姫命|qid=Q140446058}}), {{ill|Ōkuninushi|ja|大国主命|qid=Q276944}}, {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi|ja|事代主命|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 事代主}})

It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}} and was formerly an {{ill|Unranked shrines|ja|無格社|lt=Hokora|qid=Q134917285}}{{efn|Hokora|lt=Unranked Shrine|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917285|qq= 近代社格制度|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q712534}}. Also known as Aramatsubara Kōjīn Shrine, it was originally located in {{ill|Anryū|ja|安立|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11451168}}, {{ill|Suminoe-ku, Osaka|en|Suminoe-ku, Osaka|qid=Q985711|lt=Suminoe-ku}}, but was merged into Todorokihimenomikoto Shrine in {{ill|1907|en|1907|qid=Q2048|lt=1907}} ({{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}} 40).

== Festivals ==
* Spring Festival (Fire Extinguishing Festival) - April 8
* Summer Festival - July 11-12
* Autumn Festival - October 7-8
* Winter Festival (Fire Extinguishing Festival) - December 8
